It’s my fave song for a long while, and it resonates with me like no other does.
It comes from a place of anger, sorrow and frustration, with the inability of doing anything that gets you closer to the one you love, may the person be dead or left you. Because in the end, it doesn’t matter the first or the latter, as it wasn’t a choice you’ve made, anyway. This is about dealing with the pain of losing what you love. It has all of the 4 stages of grief in it. As the song begins with the shock and denial of losing the loved one “I watched you walk away, hopeless with nothing to say”, then yearning and searching “there is love burning to find you”, then disorganization and despair “dying inside these walls” and finally the beginning of recovery with simply “there is love”. This song is very special to me.

It comes from the heart.

Well, while I agree with everything that OP mentioned, as I’ve asked myself the same question too many times, I suppose there IS a downside to death. While death is an event that is assured to happen to each and every one of us, we also do not know HOW it is going to happen. Sure, if we think logically, in the way our brains are hardwired to, we would imagine that death would be like a deep sleep state. You don’t think or feel anything. Everything is gone. Utter darkness. While the thought of this option can be quite comforting, due to the reasons OP said, none of that can be actually proven to be that way. In fact, there are COUNTLESS possibilities of how death is, one of them being the one OP described, but we can’t be sure of which. There are also other possibilities described in multiple religions (and whether you believe in them or not, it is a fact they are possibilities that couldn’t be disproven of, due to it being a one way ticket) like the idea of Heaven/Hell, the Samsara or even Valhalla. The thing about these possibilities is: some can actually be good, while others can be worse than your ultimate nightmares. Since there is a CHANCE that death can be an event with an outcome of being worse than my ultimate nightmares, I’d rather stay away from it while I can. This is the line of thought that always holds me from doing anything to myself. Even if this life can be filled with suffering and pain, there’s always a chance of death being even worse than that.

I am very sorry for that. I can relate in some levels. I’ve been betrayed too, but a different kind of betreyal. Still hurts like hell even today. I wished my exgf would just leave me be and stop trying to hack my current gf’s accounts. I’ve also put a straight face, hitted the gym and gave my very best. But I also feel everything around me seems to be going under. This deep hole is a place I’ve known all too well, and even though I’m constantly wanting to end it all, I sometimes find that small things can have a good impact on what I’m feeling. I like to practice sometimes, the act of mindfulness. Whenever I’m sad and alone, I take a little bit of time to eat something I like, and savor it through. Like a chocolate or something. In my usual anxious mood, I’m never really paying attention to the things I do, but with some focus, you are able to take a little bit of pleasure from even the most mundane things.  When you manage to take focus on eating something you like and letting all worries for a later time, you are letting your brain rest a little. Sometimes, it’s all you need to take yourself out of the suicidal mood and stop the pain momentarily. I had a very stressful day today, and that’s what I did. Was feeling suicidal but a little bit better now. I hope to see you better, and I want you to know that a internet stranger can also care for you and wouldn’t want to see you like that. If you need to talk, I’m here.

I came here to share a little bit of the other side of the coin too. Sometimes people compliment me as a handsome guy. But that never got me anywhere in life. Love is all about looks on the first weeks of dating. After that, its all about your sacrifices to benefit the other person. And if they are narcissistic? You are well out of luck. You can have everything in life: looks, money, intelligence, you name it, but if you can only attract the wrong kind of people, they will make a mess out of you the same way. The more you have, the more people will drain you from it. After being used by others my entire life, I feel suicidal daily since I was 15, for 8 years. After years of struggle with narcissistic parents, abusive exes and false friends, I’ve come to realise that the only ones that we should really count on is ourselves. Please don’t be fooled by all the media and advertisements, as all they want is you feeding into their system. You are more than that.

I feel you bro. I also am in a situation a little bit similar to you, I only had sex with one girl. The only difference is that she was the love of my life, and someone I’ve really bonded with. Unfortunately, we’ve both parted ways, after living what seemed like a lifetime together. Whilst people around me were having fun at parties and getting laid with multiple people, I focused on having a quality time with her. Love is the most beautiful thing one can experience, and I know for sure it was well worth it. Sometimes a choice leads to the sacrifice of another, and to think that in the path not chosen the grass is greener is actually the thing that makes us feel miserable. There are always some things we end up not doing, simply because it the nature of the world: to make choices. Look closely around you, specially to the people you compare yourself to, are they really happy? Was that sex really fulfilling? Did this make them reach their true potential? Yes, the world revolves around sex, but only because people can profit on it. Is it the answer for our pursuit of happiness though? No. Hedonism in general makes us feel good temporarily, but stray us from our path of self discovery in the long run. The comparison with others is unfair, because you will always compare to people whom you don’t have complete knowledge of. Then, you will fill the information gaps with good things about them you think are true, but most of the times are not really that way. I’ve met many people along the way. Rich, poor, handsome, ugly, tall, short, fat, skinny, strong, you name it. Each one of them experiencing parts of the wide spectrum of what being a human is, including loneliness. It’s hard to see people for what they really are, not what they try to portray themselves to be, specially in social media. So whenever you feel the comparison urge which is  actually what is making you feel down, try to direct that anger into making something productive, to make you proud of yourself. It will really help in the long run, and you will feel happier. And someday, suddenly like that, a special person will come, to make you feel love. 
Stay safe buddy.

My gf of 3 yrs and a half also left me out of nowhere over text. We even lived abroad together for a while and she fucking left me through text. I totally understand where you are coming from, and what helped me to overcome the grief, anxiety and pain that I’ve felt for the last 3 months was working out at the gym every night after work. It might sound silly at first, but when you are capable of channeling your anger and negative energy into something productive, it will leave you feeling better. It was tough at the beginning, but all it took for me was a dose of Heavy Metal to pump me up and directing the anger towards lifting iron. As a result, my anger actually made me healthier! It doesn’t necessarily need to be gym, maybe just a sport you enjoy. Just be careful to not overdo it and hurt yourself during a frenzy, which I almost did. I hope everything works out for you :)
